strategy_roster.name: Financial Ratios Fundamental
strategy_roster.notes: Entries depend on quarterly currentRatio, interestCoverage, payableTurnover and grossMargin versus their previous periods, and the docs list no indicators at all. The DSL has no fundamental or financial-statement fields, so the never-true guard is used instead of fabricating a price proxy.

strategy_roster.name: Example of MACD Automated
strategy_roster.notes: MacdFastLength 12, MacdSlowLength 26 and MacdSignalLength 9 are documented, with the above-zero requirement standing in for the second, higher-timeframe trend filter agreeing. StopLossPoints=50 and TakeProfitPoints=30 are price-step offsets and the AdvancedMM volume accumulator is not a DSL feature, so both stops are null.

strategy_roster.name: Fisher Org v1
strategy_roster.notes: The Fisher Transform is approximated by a bounded 7-bar price z-score, and the documented trough rule is written with 1-bar and 2-bar ROC so that a local minimum at t-1 triggers the long and the mirrored peak exits. Fisher Length default 7 is used; money management is not documented.

strategy_roster.name: Franks 4 Hour Limit Orders
strategy_roster.notes: The contrarian buy limit at the previous candle low is retained and the OsMA momentum filter is approximated by a 5/13 EMA cross, since the Force Index is not whitelisted. StopLossPips=35, TakeProfitPips=150, TrailingStopPips=30 and EntryBufferPips=16 are pip values, so both stop fields are null.

strategy_roster.name: Volatility Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The documented long rule Close > SMA + Multiplier*ATR is written literally with Period=20, Multiplier=2.0 and ATR(14), and the opposite breakout supplies the exit. The stop at Multiplier*ATR from entry is a dynamic ATR distance, not a fixed percentage.

strategy_roster.name: Multi Arbitration
strategy_roster.notes: It opens a long on the first candle, adds trades toward the weaker side and force-flattens on ProfitForClose=300 or MaxOpenPositions=15, i.e. a multi-position arbitration and liquidation engine with no market-derived entry. The never-true guard prevents inventing one.

strategy_roster.name: TST Pullback Reversal
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close - low > 2 * atr(high,low,close,14)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented sharp intrabar pullback is expressed volatility-relatively: a bullish candle closing more than 2*ATR(14) above its low fades the move, and the exit waits for the 20-bar mean. GapPoints=500, StopLossPoints=500 and TakeProfitPoints=100 are instrument price steps, so both stops are null.

strategy_roster.name: Multi Time Frame Trader
strategy_roster.notes: Documented Bars=250 and StdMultiplier=2.0 are kept, but the M1/M5/H1 polynomial channels are collapsed to one series where SMA(250) plus/minus 2 standard deviations approximates the bands and the rising centre line the positive hourly slope. Degree, Shift and the channel-width stop are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Long Short Exit Risk Management
strategy_roster.notes: The documented entry is a price equality against user-configured long/short values, so this template generates no market-derived signal and the never-true guard is used. StopLossPercent=2 and TakeProfitPercent=3 plus the 10-bar time exit and 3-trades-per-day cap are left unset because no position is ever taken.

strategy_roster.name: Function Logistic Equation
strategy_roster.notes: The logistic equation of price changes is approximated by a bounded RSI(14) oscillator, so the documented 'crosses above half of the recent range' becomes a cross of 50 with the price change in the same direction. No parameters or period are documented, so RSI(14) and 14 are fallbacks.
